# TradeStation — How to import trades from TradeStation into TradeZella using the file upload method?

Source: https://help.tradezella.com/en/articles/6045045-tradestation-how-to-import-trades-from-tradestation-into-tradezella-using-the-file-upload-method

Currently, you can only import your stock and option trades using this method. Follow these steps to export your trade data from TradeStation into a file:

💡 Pro Tip: Want to effortlessly import your trades into TradeZella?​Good news! TradeZella fully supports TradeStation sync. Just head over to the Broker Sync page and follow the easy steps to connect your TradeStation account and have your trade imported automatically into TradeZella. Happy trading!🚀



## Exporting trade data from TradeStation into a file

Currently, you can only import your stock and option trades using this method.

- Go to TradeStation's web client center.

Go to TradeStation's web client center.

- Click on "Accounts" in the header panel.

Click on "Accounts" in the header panel.



- Click on "Equities Accounts" from the left panel.

Click on "Equities Accounts" from the left panel.



- Select ''Tax Center'' from the dropdown list under Equities Account

Select ''Tax Center'' from the dropdown list under Equities Account



- Under the ''Download Tax Activity'' Section, look for File Format and choose Microsoft Excel CSV.

Under the ''Download Tax Activity'' Section, look for File Format and choose Microsoft Excel CSV.

- Select the date range of trades you would like to import.

Select the date range of trades you would like to import.

- Select "Exclude Broken/Canceled Trades."

Select "Exclude Broken/Canceled Trades."

- Click "Download" and save the file to your computer.

Click "Download" and save the file to your computer.

TradeStation only allows you to download 6 months of data at a time. So, to export one year of data, you can run two exports.



## Uploading the exported file into TradeZella

- Visit the TradeZella Add Trade page here or by clicking the “Add Trade” button on the sidebar.

Visit the TradeZella Add Trade page here or by clicking the “Add Trade” button on the sidebar.

- On the Add Trade page, click “Add New Account” if you’re creating a new account for these trades.

On the Add Trade page, click “Add New Account” if you’re creating a new account for these trades.

If you’re uploading trades to an existing account, simply click on the “Add Trades” button in the account field:

- On the Add New Account page, select TradeStation as the broker and click Continue.

On the Add New Account page, select TradeStation as the broker and click Continue.

- Next, select the File Upload method and click Continue again.

Next, select the File Upload method and click Continue again.

- On the final step, select the timezone of the file and upload the file. The system will handle the rest.

On the final step, select the timezone of the file and upload the file. The system will handle the rest.



## Important notes

- Ensure Correct File Headers: For a successful file upload, ensure the exported file headers are as follows:Account Number | Type | TradeInd | Transaction | Quantity | Cusip | ADP | Symbol | CallPut | Underlying | Symbol | ExpireDate | StrikePrice | TD | SD | Activity | Date | Price | Amount | CurrencyCode | Commission | Description | Activity | Time | Order ID

- Account Number | Type | TradeInd | Transaction | Quantity | Cusip | ADP | Symbol | CallPut | Underlying | Symbol | ExpireDate | StrikePrice | TD | SD | Activity | Date | Price | Amount | CurrencyCode | Commission | Description | Activity | Time | Order ID
